title: CustomEvents
description: Allows players to track event status, and also includes various pre-prepared events. Highly customizable.
body:
> ### What is a CustomEvents?
> CustomEvent is an event plugin that gives your players the ability to set custom goals and receive rewards for achieving them.
##
> ### Getting Started
>**1.** _Use the ```/customevent``` command._
>
>**2.** In the menu that opens, click the Create Event button.
>
>**3.** By clicking on them, you can select the Event Name, Event Reward (optional), and the conditions under which the event will take place (e.g., Number of Active Players).
##
> ### What exactly can I do with CustomEvents?
> **Create Custom Goals:** Add objectives for your players, such as blocks broken, active player counts, or item crafting.
> 
> **Reward Goal Achievement:** Automatically grant special rewards to your players once an event reaches its target.
> 
> **Keep Your Server Alive:** Give your players a reason to stay active and excited by challenging them with live events.
